note: importedFiles are SHA-256 hashes of the files as first vendored in phone-use commit a8aa285. That commit recorded src/ as unmodified upstream, while Cargo.toml already carried the local edits listed below; neither was re-verified against an upstream archive, so upstreamArchiveSha256 and upstream file hashes are unknown.
changes: Cargo.toml: expand workspace inheritance into explicit versions, fix the omnisette path, use reqwest rustls-no-provider (no aws-lc-rs), omnisette with default-features = false and remote-anisette/remote-anisette-v3 only.
src/lib.rs: disable HTTP idle connection reuse so Apple login does not reuse a connection the server reset (marked as a local MPL-2.0 modification in the file).

src/utils/certificate.rs: share valid team signing identities across sessions of the same account and runtime, serialize certificate creation, migrate legacy identities, keep pending keys and fail safely at the certificate quota (phone-use 2094553, b65b68b); Cargo.toml adds tokio time/macros and libc for this.
src/developer/qh/certs.rs: tolerate missing status, status_code and expiration_date in certificate listings (serde defaults).
